changes: Added apps/agent-runtime/src/matching, the runtime half of spec #2's 'apps/agent-runtime receives validated profiles and vacancies, then calls packages/solver' seam required by issue #20.

Implemented MatchingService.nominateForCandidate and MatchingService.evaluatePair, which geocode inputs, project the domain documents onto the solver contracts, and call @puente/solver nominate/evaluateMatch.

Added geocode.ts: a GeocodingPort mapping the textual domain Location onto the solver GeoPoint, with a deterministic Panama catalog as the offline default and a Google Geocoding adapter used when a key is configured; provider failures fall back to the catalog with a recorded fallbackReason.

Added config.ts: matchingConfigFromEnv drives both the Distance Matrix routing port and the geocoding port from GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY, so the production routing path uses Google Maps when configured and the local matrix otherwise.

Added adapt.ts: JobRequirements -> SolverVacancy (projecting only getRankableRequirements, preserving original wording) and CandidateProfile -> SolverCandidate, with arrays copied so the solver cannot mutate caller state.

Bridged the two skill-id spaces: the profile layer emits plp:* ids while vacancy requirements carry ESCO-shaped PA-* ids, so toSolverCandidate re-matches each profile skill against the vacancy taxonomy. Without this every mandatory-skill comparison would fail.
Blocked vacancies are skipped rather than scored; MatchingService throws MatchingInputError when no rankable vacancy is supplied.
Exported the seam from apps/agent-runtime and declared @puente/solver as a workspace dependency; documented GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY in .env.example and the seam in apps/agent-runtime/README.md.
Added 26 Vitest tests across geocode, config, adapt, and service.

skipped: Live Google Maps Distance Matrix and Geocoding calls: exercised with an injected fetch so the suite stays hermetic and offline.
validation.notes: 419/419 tests pass (26 new matching tests; the prior suite was 393). Coverage 93.89% lines / 82.37% branches (gate-ci threshold is 80% lines / 70% branches). lint and tsc --noEmit are clean.

riskRemaining: The Google Distance Matrix and Geocoding adapters are covered by injected-fetch tests, not live calls. CandidateMatchContext and VacancyMatchContext carry the facts the solver needs but the profile/vacancy documents do not (schedule, salary, capacity, transport, availability, home location); they are explicit inputs today and are not yet sourced from the preferences ticket (#7) or an extended JobRequirements. The workflow's market_and_matching step still uses the LLM path; it does not yet invoke MatchingService, which is wired but consumed only through the exported seam.
